name: Fujikawaguchiko (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fujikawaguchiko town emblem in green and blue: a green stylised mountain within a blue swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Fujikawaguchiko, a town in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 November 2003.

features.role: Fujikawaguchiko town emblem — a green stylised mountain within a blue swirl
